# Customer Churn Prediction System

## Project Overview
This project predicts whether a customer is likely to churn using Machine Learning.

## Technologies Used
- Python
- Jupyter Notebook
- Streamlit
- Pandas
- NumPy
- Matplotlib
- Plotly
- Scikit-learn
- PostgreSQL (optional)
- SQLAlchemy

## Project Structure

Customer_Churn_Project/
│
├── app.py
├── requirements.txt
├── README.md
├── assets/
├── data/
├── models/
├── notebook/
└── outputs/

## Features
- Upload customer dataset
- Data cleaning
- Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
- Feature Engineering
- Machine Learning Model Training
- Customer Churn Prediction
- Business Reports Dashboard
- Download prediction results

## Machine Learning Models
- Logistic Regression
- Random Forest Classifier

## Dataset
Customer Churn Dataset (1000 rows)
